paper.title_en: Nonstandard quantum statistics for strongly correlated systems: Superexclusion in momentum space and comparison with exact results
paper.abstract_en: We analyze in detail nonstandard statistics for strongly correlated fermions, which comprise the statistical spin liquid (SSL) and model non-Fermi liquid (NFL) cases. Both of those cases are based on the total exclusion of local doubly occupancies ($the~superexclusion$) either in real space (SSL case) or in reciprocal ($\mathbf{k}$) space (NFL). The results obtained on a purely physical ground are supplemented with the exact analysis of those coming from microscopic Hubbard-like model in $\mathbf{k}$ space. Specifically, we discuss the transmutation of those statistics to that of localized magnetic moments, as well as the transformation of the Fermi liquid into a strongly correlated fermionic liquid or Mott insulating state; the latter taking place for the half-filled-band situation. The role of exclusion of double occupancies in either real or reciprocal space in the appearance of the correlated phase is stressed. Conclusions concerning the universal features of the models, independence of either the real- or $\mathbf{k}$-space representation, are also discussed. One of those is the boson to fermion statistics transmutation which in the limit of strong repulsive interboson interaction leads to the particle localization instead to the Bose-Einstein condensation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文从统计层面研究强关联费米子系统中的非费米液体与超排除概念，并与Hubbard类模型的精确结果进行对照，属于凝聚态强关联与全息凝聚态方向的关联主题；方法涉及模型分析与物理图像论证，适合点入进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 强关联系统的非标准量子统计：动量空间中的超排除及与精确结果的比较
decision.abstract_zh: 我们详细分析了强关联费米子的非标准统计，其中包括统计自旋液体（SSL）和模型非费米液体（NFL）两种情形。这两种情形都基于对局域双重占据（即“超排除”）的完全排除，或者是在实空间（SSL情形）中，或者是在倒（$\mathbf{k}$）空间中（NFL情形）。在纯物理基础上得到的结果，辅以对来自$\mathbf{k}$空间中微观Hubbard类模型的结果的精确分析。具体而言，我们讨论了这些统计向局域磁矩统计的嬗变，以及费米液体向强关联费米液体或Mott绝缘态的转变；后者发生在半满带情形下。我们强调了实空间或倒空间中双重占据的排除在关联相出现中所起的作用。我们还讨论了关于模型普遍特征、与实空间或$\mathbf{k}$空间表示无关的结论。其中之一是玻色子到费米子统计的嬗变，其在强排斥性玻色子间相互作用极限下导致粒子局域化，而不是玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚。
